# The 6% is not what you keep. The affiliate return is.

> Free TikTok Shop profit calculator. See referral fees, creator commission, returns that keep the affiliate payout, and the announced 1 Oct 2026 8% + 1.5% schedule on the same SKU.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
